name: bonumark-stream
tagline: A self-hosted microblog CMS for publishing short-form posts on a site you control.
description: The next public milestone after v0.6.0, consolidating locked-down hosting support, owner-run upgrades, shared upgrade/recovery logic, deployment verification, Nginx guidance, and explicit MySQL/MariaDB compatibility. The v0.7.2 candidate also corrects the database smoke-test model so current fresh installs and historical v0.4.x upgrades are validated separately. Adds no new database migration.
title: Hosting Portability & Upgrade Workflow
label: Hosting Portability & Upgrade Workflow
